summary: Scorpio Tankers Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, disclosing an update on its daily Time Charter Equivalent (TCE) rates for the second quarter of 2026. The filing provides average daily TCE revenue and expected revenue days for LR2, MR, and Handymax vessels across pool/spot, time charter, and bareboat charter segments, along with an estimate of fully diluted weighted average shares outstanding of 53-54 million for Q2 2026. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is present; this is a routine operational update.
